lines: They fell asleep in a cave... and woke up in a different world!
How long did they sleep? A: one hundred years. B: forty years. C: three hundred and nine years. Three... two... one!
The answer is C! Three hundred and nine years!
Allah says in Surah Al-Kahf: And they remained in their cave three hundred years, and exceeded by nine.
And when they woke up... they thought they had slept only a day, or part of a day.
Three centuries passed... in what felt like a single day.
Did you get it right? Comment A, B or C!
